The Old Ferry: Real ale and river views, at 1 Ferry Lane (example), Newark.
Sunday: 11am till 8pm. Tuesday to Saturday: 11am till 11:30pm. Closed Mondays.

Seating: the bar (5 tables), dining room (11 tables), beer garden (6 tables, walk-in only) and the loft (2 tables, private hire by enquiry). The beer garden is first come, first served, not bookable. We keep some tables back for walk-ins.
Food from 12:30pm until 8:30pm. Drinks until close.
14 tables can be booked; 10 tables first come or by enquiry. Children welcome any time. Dogs welcome everywhere.
32 items on the menu and drinks list.
